title: Cohomology of a finite projective complex over a coherent ring
statement: Let R be a commutative coherent ring, meaning that every finitely generated ideal of R is finitely presented. Let P^\bullet be a bounded cochain complex of finite projective R-modules (the affine form of a strictly perfect complex [def-pc-perfect-complex]). Then each cohomology module H^q(P^\bullet) is finitely presented over R.

source.place: More on Algebra, Lemma 0EWZ (over a coherent ring a pseudo-coherent complex has coherent cohomology), with Algebra, Lemma 05CX (coherent = finitely presented over a coherent ring)

proof.text: For every n, install the finite and projective hypotheses hterms n and apply Mathlib Module.finitePresentation_of_projective. Let S=P.sc q, with the terms at the preceding, current and following degree. Apply Module.finitePresentation_ker_range_cokernel_of_fg_ideals to S.g.hom to obtain finite presentation of the cycle module LinearMap.ker S.g.hom.

The incoming differential factors through cycles by the square-zero identity, using Mathlib ShortComplex.moduleCatToCycles. Its source S.X₁ and target LinearMap.ker S.g.hom are finitely presented. Apply the cokernel clause of Module.finitePresentation_ker_range_cokernel_of_fg_ideals to this map. The resulting quotient is the explicit homology module. Transport finite presentation to P.homology q along ShortComplex.moduleCatHomologyIso.toLinearEquiv.symm by Module.FinitePresentation.of_equiv. No separate finite-presentation calculation for the boundary module and no use of boundedness are required.

lean.statement: theorem finitePresentation_homology_of_coherent {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (hR : ∀ I : Ideal R, I.FG → Module.FinitePresentation R I) (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (P.X n)) (hterms : ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite R (P.X n) ∧ Module.Projective R (P.X n)) (q : ℤ) : Module.FinitePresentation R (P.homology q)
